d.title: City Hunter: Ai to Shukumei no Magnum
d.jp: シティーハンター 愛と宿命のマグナム
syn: City Hunter: A Magnum of Love's Destination
City Hunter: Magnum of Love and Destiny
City Hunter: Magnum of Love and Fate
d.synopsis: A beautiful pianist comes to Tokyo for a charity concert, and City Hunter is there. But music isn`t his forte; he wants lessons in the language of love. Desperation becomes the word of the day as the bodies start dropping. A foreign dignitary is assassinated in cold blood. Secret agents scour the streets for a missing microchip. Diplomatic infighting swirls around the upcoming concert, and City Hunter is the only hope!
